question:
Select the correct option to substitute the given set of words.

one who cannot be corrected
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"one who cannot be corrected"** refers to someone who is beyond reform or correction. (जो सुधारा नहीं जा सकता)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite multiple warnings, his behavior remained **incorrigible.**
 
 
 
• **"Incorrigible"** means someone who is not able to be corrected, improved, or reformed. (असुधार्य)
 
 
• **Example: **His** incorrigible** habit of lying made it difficult for people to trust him.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct term for "one who cannot be corrected" is **'incorrigible'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vulnerable** (असुरक्षित): Susceptible to physical or emotional harm.

 
 
• **Example:** The child felt** vulnerable** without his parents around.
 
 
 
• **Versatile** (बहुमुखी): Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a** versatile** actress who can perform in both comedies and dramas.
 
 
 
• **Indefatigable** (अथक): Persisting tirelessly.
 
 
• **Example:** Her **indefatigable **efforts in the project were commendable.
